THETAILOR-CRAFT_KIT.title: Craft Kit
THETAILOR-CRAFT_KIT.description: At the start of combat, create a [gold]Leather Minion[/gold].
THETAILOR-CRAFT_KIT.flavor:
The leather's feelin' so BOVINE, still! It's itchin' to be a cow again!! And they call it dead?
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-MASTERS_TOOLSET.title: Master's Toolset
THETAILOR-MASTERS_TOOLSET.description: At the start of combat, create [blue]2[/blue] random non-Leather Minions and trigger their abilities.
THETAILOR-MASTERS_TOOLSET.flavor:
Use 'em wisely, boy. Yeah, they're the same tools as yours- just use 'em like a master!!
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-TOUGH_TROUSERS.title: Tough Trousers
THETAILOR-TOUGH_TROUSERS.description: Minions are created with [blue]{Heal}[/blue] additional max HP.
THETAILOR-TOUGH_TROUSERS.flavor:
Do somethin' these new green guildsmen aren't gonna do for threat of their coin: Make somethin' that lasts!!
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-STRIPED_SCARF.title: Striped Scarf
THETAILOR-STRIPED_SCARF.description: At the end of your first turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies for each Minion you have.
THETAILOR-STRIPED_SCARF.flavor:
Tuesdays are for stripes, yeah. Thursdays are for stripes too!!
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-VELVET_GLOVE.title: Velvet Glove
THETAILOR-VELVET_GLOVE.flavor:
Nah, I never made a silk as soft as you have, boy. These old hands are blunt weapons...
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-LIVING_NEEDLE.title: Living Needle
THETAILOR-LIVING_NEEDLE.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Stitch[/gold] two cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THETAILOR-LIVING_NEEDLE.flavor:
A land exists where these are the bees, and their flowers are fabric. Trust me, boy- I dreamt it!!
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-PATIENT_PATCH.title: Patient Patch
THETAILOR-PATIENT_PATCH.description: [gold]Patches[/gold] gain [gold]Retain[/gold]. The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] times you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card each combat, add a [gold]Patch[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THETAILOR-PATIENT_PATCH.flavor:
Never saw you sit down for a break, boy. Not once!! Where the hell'd you get that energy from?
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-LIFE_ESSENCE.title: Life Essence
THETAILOR-LIFE_ESSENCE.description: Whenever a Minion is created, trigger its ability.
THETAILOR-LIFE_ESSENCE.flavor:
Everything's got life in it, boy. Especially you!! You've just gotta share some.
- Guildmaster Kress
THETAILOR-MINION_CRITIC.title: Minion Critic
THETAILOR-MINION_CRITIC.description: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card and destroy your rightmost Minion.
THETAILOR-MINION_CRITIC.flavor:
Mine Master left not a note with this thing. I herefore recount an idle musing on his behalf: 'Don't trust a critic in fancy dress!'
- The Tailor
